race.comment: The feature of the day now and CORRECT CHOICE (6) makes the most appeal. He ended last campaign in top order over the mile here in what ended up being a strong form reference. His recent trial was solid and the inside draw should see him get every chance. Can pick up from where he left off. CHARINO (4) bounced back with a bang last start, storming over the top to win at this track and trip with that form being franked here last week. He drops a stack of weight and the wide draw is no issue with his racing pattern. Can raise the bar. ROYAL TORONADO (9) has trialled impressively coming into this, though he is 0/6 when fresh in the past. Short of his best trip, but Pike sticks with him and he can make an impression. TOO DARDY (3) is hard to knock on his recent form and can play a leading role.
